newsitem.title: ITALY: Ambroveneto sees higher 1996 net profits.
newsitem.headline: Ambroveneto sees higher 1996 net profits.

text.p: One of Italy's largest banks Banco Ambrosiano Veneto announced that it expected its 1996 results to show a rise in net profits from the 160 billion lire net result recorded in 1995.

In a statement, the bank said that client deposits rose to around 32.7 trillion lire, a rise of nine percent from 30.027 trillion lire at end-1995. It added that total administered customer assets rose 15 percent to 84.7 trillion lire.
The bank also added that its client loans had risen 16 percent to 28.0 trillion lire over the year to end-1996.
